scope: Pre-execution mathematical, source-semantics, chronology, domain and resource review. No canonical checkpoint/observation bytes inspected or model propagations executed.

math_review.factor: Packed lower-triangular L, P=L L^T. Nodes use columns, mu±4L[:,k], equal population weights1/32, including repeated nodes for rank deficiency. This reconstructs the stated first two chart moments.
math_review.linearized: mu_minus=f(mu,dt,I); B=F(mu,dt,I)L; g=dh/dx at mu_minus. Predictive variance is ||gB||^2+sigmaV^2, preserving all correlations and adding observation noise exactly once. No process/current/time noise is introduced.
math_review.nonlinear: Complete admitted32point rules provide approximate nonlinear voltage mean and population variance; add the same sigmaV^2 once. These are cubature moments of the retained local Gaussian, not exact posterior/predictive moments or calibrated coverage.
math_review.bounded_scalar_condition: For X in[a,b], E[(X-a)(b-X)]>=0 implies Var(X)<=(b-mu)(mu-a). The recorded128eps(b-a)^2 allowance is numerical only. A violation contradicts that bounded moment interpretation; passing is not sufficient for joint support or calibration.
math_review.comparison_scales: 0.1sigmaV mean and0.1sigmaV^2 variance shifts are acceptable frozen noise-referenced prioritization scales. They are distinct from arithmetic tolerances and do not bound accumulated likelihood effects.

chronology_review.next_observation: Read stored input index n from byte offset32*n; apply its exact dt/current and produce endpoint n+1.
chronology_review.reference_exclusion: Checkpoint last_prediction/last_innovation_variance refer to the preceding update and are not the new forecast reference.
chronology_review.phase_change: Current may change at the selected checkpoint; next archived input determines the probe.

domain_review.pre_and_post: Check all16public chart-coordinate bounds before propagation; unchanged physical-step checks and full post-coordinate admission afterward.
domain_review.failure_semantics: Any invalid node invalidates the complete component moment rule. Preserve individually admitted values as diagnostics only. No clipping, dropping, replacement or renormalization.
domain_review.interpretation: Invalid-node fractions are not Gaussian tail probabilities. All nodes admitted does not prove bounded Gaussian support. The known later h=1positivevariance witness is not attributed to the earlier weight switch.
domain_review.center: Six centers are propagated separately; production-order voltage comparison uses the same propagated center without a second physical step.

meaningful_fabricated_checks: Dense off-diagonal factor node mean/covariance reconstruction; catches packed indexing and missing correlations.
Zero-covariance identity: all nodes equal center, latent variance0, predictive variance sigmaV^2 exactly once.
Interior directional derivative/linearized reference checks under positive, negative and zero current.
Initial h boundary and post-propagation SOC boundary failures suppress component moments without changing node weights.
Wrong observation index is rejected; checkpoint/live state stays unchanged.
